comments.author: BonnyLass
comments.body: Hmm, the Ghanjah Dhow certainly looks nice enough, but levels not withstanding, how does this compare to other mainstays like the Trading Large Galleon in categories such as maxed cargo?

comments.author: Yaknow
comments.body:
trading large galleon +25% = 1037 hold, 64 minimum crew, 30 minimum cannons, for a cargo hold of 943
ghanjah dhow +25% = 1000 hold, 36 minumum crew, 12 minimum cannons, for a cargo hold of 952

So it's pretty much dead even, but the dhow isn't a bathtub with bedsheets, it will actually move.

comments.author: BonnyLass
comments.body: Well, I'm sold! This ship sounds like a fine alternative to the bathtub with sheets. Thank you kindly for the helpful answer.
